verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an inference platform, but every item in the pack describes a Fernworks-managed service: you call api.fireworks.ai, and Fireworks runs the GPUs and its own global fleet. The only open-source item is a benchmarking tool, not the core product, and there is no evidence of a self-hosted, on-prem or bring-your-own-cloud deployment of the platform.
